channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Ladybirds turn back Warriors in chase for Big East lead
item.description: Southern Nash’s stingy defense stuffs Hunt in a second-half surge, 41-28, lifting the Ladybirds into a tie for second in the Big East while the Warriors slip to the league cellar.

item.title: Hunt boys zip past Southern Nash for 8th straight win
item.description: No. 6 Hunt routed Southern Nash 70-30 for its eighth straight win, moving to 9-1 and 3-0 in Big East play and setting up a first-place clash at unbeaten Northern Nash on Tuesday.

item.title: State Board of Elections to hear Knight’s appeal Tuesday morning
item.description: Wilson County sheriff hopeful Bobby Knight filed an appeal to the State Board of Elections over the county board's decision to uphold two candidate challenges, deeming Knight ineligible to run for office.

item.title: Down to Business: Sabor Salvadoreño serves authentic El Salvadorian dishes
item.description: Wilson’s Sabor Salvadoreño food truck brings homemade El Salvadoran pupusas, tamales and more to town.

item.title: Gillette generates big revenue for the community
item.description: The J. Burt Gillette Athletic Complex generated more than $5.3 million for Wilson in 2024 with even greater economic impact expected in the future as pickleball tournaments grow in popularity.

item.title: Area Calendar, Jan. 13-15, 2026
item.description: Area high school action heats up Jan. 12-13 with a full slate of boys, girls and JV basketball plus wrestling, featuring Wilson, Rocky Mount, Nash and regional rivals.

item.title: Evans catches fire as No. 6 Duke survives No. 24 SMU in another defensive letdown
item.description: Isiah Evans' 21 points lift No. 6 Duke past No. 24 SMU 82-75, masking another shaky defensive showing as Jon Scheyer juggles lineups and searches for the Blue Devils' old identity.

item.title: Lees-McRae pulls away from Barton women for 68-56 win
item.description: Hot first-half shooting and a 21-4 opening burst lifted Lees-McRae to a 68-56 road win over Barton, spoiling Lauren Mingo’s double-double despite the Bulldogs’ late surge.

item.title: Fields’ career night lifts Barton over Lees-McRae, 88-67
item.description: Trey Fields’ 33-point double-double and a dominant first half powered Barton past Lees-McRae 88-67, snapping a three-game skid behind hot shooting, bench depth and a 50-22 halftime cushion.

item.title: AREA ROUNDUP: Knights wear down Harrells in key CPIC clash
item.description: Top-ranked Greenfield boys outlast Harrells Christian 71-63 behind Cameron Moore and Kobe Edwards in a key CPIC clash, while Wilson Christian’s girls see a late lead disappear in a pivotal region loss at Greenville Christian.
